body:
New gui-job CI step (main-push only): emily session new for build provenance, GPG-signs both platform artifacts, publishes to IDUNA's new /api/v1/app-releases with real GitHub commit/run provenance. Guarded no-op until 2 GitHub secrets exist (human-only step, see IDUNA/docs/APP_RELEASE_SIGNING.md). Found and fixed 2 real bugs before committing (wrong emily.cli repo/build path, missing closing quote) -- verified by actually running the extracted step end to end against live IDUNA. DEADWEIGHT 7046100.

⚓ ☃
title: CI signs + publishes releases to IDUNA's app-release registry
